notes: Car lock: the email signal behind the cloud car lock now retries every 30 seconds until the lock is confirmed — it no longer stops after 10 tries. The 10-send mark is now just a heads-up notification; the resends keep going every 30 seconds until confirmation lands, so a lock request made with no signal (garage, elevator) still goes through once a connection is back. Plus everything in 3.7.7 and earlier.
